resources.string: Autostart killer for HONOR MagicOS (private build)
Disables app autostart on HONOR MagicOS

Hushd uses the AccessibilityService API to toggle autostart switches inside the HONOR Phone Manager UI on your behalf. It never accesses the network and never sees events from other apps — it is scoped to the system settings packages only.

Hushd controls another app\'s UI through Android\'s AccessibilityService. It is built for HONOR MagicOS 7/8 on the HONOR Magic V2. It clicks buttons in the HONOR Phone Manager just like you would. It does not access network, does not collect data, and never sends anything off-device. UI automation may break on future MagicOS updates without warning. You run this on your own device, at your own risk.
